purpose: Exact paths whose historical secret authority is proven dead. Each entry is verified against git metadata on every preflight run; a stale entry cannot pass. This file is NOT a way to ignore history secrets in general - there is no pattern or wildcard form, and every other secret-class finding keeps blocking.

entries.authority_target: legacy Railway PostgreSQL service behind trolley.proxy.rlwy.net:47583, database "railway" - documented by Repo B as "Legacy enrichment sandbox - archive after Phase A"
entries.not_the_production_sot: Production SoT is DATABASE_URL_TIMESCALE / DATABASE_URL against the TimescaleDB service (ballast.proxy.rlwy.net). This entry says nothing about those credentials.

human_attestation.statement: The target legacy Railway PostgreSQL service was deleted by a human operator. The historical credential therefore addresses no reachable service and carries no live authority. Confirmed together with the merge of Repo-B PR #547.
